scope: GPU operator availability and fallback reporting for the DirectML lane
why: The DirectML SDK is configure-time detected and KHANARY_HAS_DIRECTML is defined for the runtime target, but no DirectML API object is instantiated: DMLOps compiles an HLSL compute kernel and dispatches it through D3D11. A configure flag is a build fact, not a runtime capability, so compiled/enabled/available/used/fallback are reported as five separate facts with an explicit PASS/FAIL/UNAVAILABLE lane.

laws.D1: compiled is a build fact reported from the KHANARY_HAS_DIRECTML definition and is never inferred from a runtime probe
laws.D3: available implies a live D3D11 device and at least one compiled kernel
laws.D4: used implies enabled, and used is set only by an operator the DirectML operator path served
laws.D5: an operator served by the non-DML path increments fallback_ops and is never reported as a DirectML execution
laws.D6: an operator refused before any path ran increments refused_ops and is never counted as a fallback
laws.D7: the presence of a DirectML API token in the operator source and the declared operator_path.implemented value must agree, so a configure flag alone can never be read as an enabled operator path

operator_path.reason: no DirectML API object is instantiated; DMLOps compiles and dispatches an HLSL compute kernel through D3D11
operator_path.to_enable: instantiate IDMLDevice/IDMLCompiledOperator in src/gpu/dml_ops.cpp, flip implemented to true, and prove the D1-D7 laws against a real DirectML operator execution

cases.report_shape: every report_keys field is present in the emitted report
cases.law_D2: enabled is false whenever compiled or operator_path_implemented is false
cases.law_D3: available is false whenever the device is absent or no kernel is ready
cases.law_D4: used is false unless the DirectML operator path executed an operator
cases.law_D5: a GEMM served by the CPU fallback increments fallback_ops and leaves used false
cases.law_D6: a GEMM with a null operand increments refused_ops and not fallback_ops
cases.law_D7: the API-token scan of the operator source agrees with operator_path.implemented
cases.gemm_reference: a GEMM executed on the available GPU path equals an independently computed host reference within 1e-4 absolute tolerance
cases.gemm_forced_fallback: alpha != 1 forces the CPU fallback path and produces the alpha-scaled reference exactly
cases.lane_status: PASS when every law above holds in this build, UNAVAILABLE when no device can execute a GPU path, FAIL otherwise
